about: Tavily finds nothing for the query

trigger.node: Provide search topic via Chat window

images.description: Diagram of a retriever feeding documents to a language model

connector.none: no captured search connector; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: HTTP Request v4.2, raw body (application/json) built as a string: POST https://api.tavily.com/search {api_key: the Set node's 'tvly-YOUR_API_KEY' placeholder, query: the chat input, search_depth basic, include_images, include_image_descriptions, max_results 5}. The key is the template's placeholder and the mock does not check it (real Tavily would answer 401). Filter > 90% keeps results with score > 0.80 and Get Top Result takes the first. Response shape from Tavily's docs, assumed

connector.none: no captured extraction connector; the Claude side serves the same response through its HTTP mock

reads.note: POST https://api.tavily.com/extract {api_key, urls: [top result url]}; Summarize Web Page Content reads results[0].raw_content

branches: Filter leaves an empty list, Get Top Result sets results to undefined, and Tavily Extract Top Search fails resolving $json.results.url (an expression error) before any extract request
expect.offline: The summary is model-driven (n8n's reply is recorded) and is the chat reply, the only effect. The unconnected Tavily Search and Tavily Extract nodes (static examples) are not on the chat path
